sources.fullCitation: Allan Jones. “The Show Must Go On.” On You are Love, Bamboodi. Distributed by Believe, released 29 January 2018; words and music credited to Roger Edens, Walter Jurmann, Gus Kahn and Bronislaw Kaper. Digital audio reference. Accessed 25 August 2026.
sources.title: The Show Must Go On — Allan Jones
sources.creator: Allan Jones, vocal
sources.researchNote: The release presents a modern transfer of Jones's performance recorded for Everybody Sing in 1938 and names no session, label, catalogue number or matrix. No contemporary disc under Jones's name was found in the consulted discographic literature or among his eight His Master's Voice sides in the Great 78 Project. It replaces an Audiomack page that carried the same performance without credits and refused playback outside its licensed territories.
